title: Normalized strict augmented coefficient square presentation
statement: Let $S,T,X,Y$ be small ringed sites and $f:X\to S$, $g:T\to S$, $h:Y\to X$, $e:Y\to T$ a ring-compatible square [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-square-presentation], with exact module inverse images. Use the strict tower categories and their normalized total-derived direct images and inverse limits [def-sbc-strict-projection-tower-data]. A normalized augmented reduction presentation at a corner $W$ consists of a strict sequence $Q_W$ of complexes, an augmentation $z_W:\Delta O_W[0]\to Q_W$, the total left derived functor $\mathcal R_W$ of direct-sum-totalized tensor $M\mapsto\Delta M\otimes Q_W$, its universal comparison, and its augmentation. The comparison is invertible on flat-term K-flat representatives; there the augmentation is induced by $1\otimes z_W$. A pullback comparison is a strict coefficient isomorphism commuting with augmentations and a derived reduction isomorphism normalized by the ordinary tensor pullback map on such representatives. A coefficient square presentation consists of these data at all four corners and edges, with the coefficient pullback square commuting before localization. Also define the constant-tower comparison normalized by the ordinary constant/limit adjunction unit, the tower adjunction normalized by its ordinary transpose, the projection map as transpose of pullback followed by counit, and the strict tower square and its mate.
